hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook backed by Euler Protocol vaults. In beforeSwap, it fully handles the swap: taking input tokens from PoolManager, depositing them to Euler vaults, computing output via a custom bonding curve, withdrawing output tokens from vaults, and returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Standard LP positions and donations are blocked via revert on beforeAddLiquidity and beforeDonate.
